description: This file defines the class DataFile2EntityXml, which provides functionality to generate XML representations of data files for the OFBiz framework. It includes methods to write entity data to XML files and a main method for command-line execution, involving reading data files and producing XML output.

classes.name: DataFile2EntityXml
classes.description: Utility class for converting data files into XML format within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: writeToEntityXml
methods.description: Writes the data from a DataFile object into an XML file representing entity data, including handling nulls and string encoding.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Command-line entry point that reads a data file and definition, and writes their XML representation to an output file.
